transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the litigation reserve release review. As we all know, we have a $3,000,000 litigation reserve on the year-end trial balance, and the draft close memo proposes that the matter will cost $600,000, with a release of $2,400,000. Before I make the final accounting decision to post the journal entry, I need to do my routine round-robin check with legal and tax. So let's walk through this together. First, can legal confirm the $600,000 estimated cost and provide any updated assessment of the matter? And can tax weigh in on any tax implications of the reserve release? Once I have your input, I'll state the complete reserve arithmetic and we'll assign action items before finalizing.

I have not yet circulated this memo to the close team, but it clearly needs to be factored into our reserve release review and disclosure work.
